body: The axe and seed sack have silver specks on them. I think they're from the orchard treatment. They were packed before the crossing was barricaded.
title: Axe and seed sack

body: The group burned the map after the marked road failed them. One corner survived with an arrow pointing to a station that had stopped taking arrivals. I recognized my own handwriting on the corner; I had copied the directions from a uniformed man.
title: Letter
